items.title: Builder bootstrap: build, run, record baseline

brief.goal: The game builds and runs on the developer's machine and a first perf baseline is recorded in the queue.
units: chore: run python3 tools/bootstrap.py; fix anything it reports missing (SDL3 is fetched automatically if not installed)
chore: cmake --preset dev (win-dev on Windows) && cmake --build --preset dev && ctest --preset dev; note the first-build wall time
chore: run ./build/dev/bin/peo 7 and complete every manual step below
docs: if any step on this OS needed an extra package or flag, add it to README.md under Build (one line each)
acceptance: python3 tools/verify.py --frontend passes on the developer's machine
the game window opens, @ moves with arrows/WASD, h units approach the player
the report note contains OS, compiler, first-build time, and the Release-preset numbers below
manual: Launch ./build/dev/bin/peo 7. Expect an 80x45 map of # and . with @ near the left edge and > near the right.
Stand still 30 ticks (3 s). Expect red h glyphs to converge on @ from multiple directions.
Shift+S toggles the scent view. Expect a gradient (@ + : .) centred on the player that follows you as you walk.
Walk into the > cell. Expect the HUD stage counter to become 1 and a denser map.
Press N five times. Expect stage 6 to have visibly more walls than stage 0.
Build the release preset and run it: watch the HUD for hitching while 40 h units move. Report anything not smooth.
Perf baseline: run ./build/headless-release/tests/peo_core_tests -tc='*thousand*' -d and report the duration doctest prints.
out_of_scope: gameplay changes of any kind; record ideas with /work

items.title: Introduce World as the single tick owner

brief.goal: Frontend calls one World::tick(); all simulation state lives in core.
units: core: add src/core/include/peo/core/world.hpp with class World { explicit World(Seed); void load_stage(uint32_t); bool try_move_player(Vec2i delta); void tick(); const Stage& stage() const; const ScentField& scent() const; const std::vector<Hordeling>& horde() const; Vec2i player() const; Tick tick_count() const; uint32_t stage_index() const; }. Constants kInitialHorde and kPlayerScent move into a WorldParams struct with defaults.

core: implement src/core/src/world.cpp by moving load_stage/try_move/simulate out of main.cpp verbatim; reaching the exit inside try_move_player loads the next stage. Add world.cpp to src/core/CMakeLists.txt.

test: tests/core/test_world.cpp — 'same seed same world after 100 ticks' (compare player, horde positions, scent total for two Worlds), 'player cannot enter walls', 'reaching exit advances stage_index'. Register in tests/CMakeLists.txt.
app: main.cpp keeps only SDL setup, key mapping, and draw(); App holds a World and calls world.tick() on the fixed timestep.
docs: update the 'Planned seams' section of docs/architecture.md: World is built.
acceptance: src/app/main.cpp contains no simulation logic: no ScentField, Rng or Hordeling manipulation, only World calls and drawing
the three new world tests pass and the suite stays under 500 ms
the game plays exactly as before (manual steps below)
manual: Run ./build/dev/bin/peo 7 and repeat PEO-001 steps 1-4. Behaviour must be identical.
Pause with space, walk, unpause: hordelings must not teleport (tick catch-up bug check).

notes.text: briefed; Architect will write test_world.cpp expectations on request, Builder may write them per unit 3

items.title: Blood scent layer on hordeling contact

brief.goal: Touching the player leaves blood, a second scent layer hordes follow more strongly than trail.
A headless-release benchmark prints microseconds per step and the number is recorded for the vision target.
Stages alternate between open random walls and cellular-automata caves with a guaranteed entry-exit path.

items.title: Replay: seed plus input log reproduces a run headlessly

brief.goal: A replay file lets the Architect reproduce any Builder-reported bug in a test.
